## Dispatch order · `domain:ui#5` · `session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C` · 2026-10-29T04:02Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#27372, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone: read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` and `ui/AGENTS.md` before your first edit, and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself through REST (`curl -sS "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/27372" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`, every page); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Take another ui lane seat" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-27372` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27372 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{WAS:…}}` / the now-token). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, line 3 `Fixes #27372`, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is a gate on every ui card. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes (`@object-ui/i18n` patch for namespace rows; app-shell is `private: true`). ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Take another ui lane seat" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.
Collision check: ui seats 1 and 2 both answered at 2026-10-29T03:56Z that neither holds an order, claim or plan on #27355 rows 2–4. **Serial constraint (from seat 2):** its #27347, PR #27361 (in contract review), edits plugin-dashboard `DatasetWidget.tsx`, `MetricWidget.tsx`, `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx`, `index.tsx` and `utils.ts`, and regenerates the sdui manifest. If your diff touches `DatasetWidget.tsx` or `utils.ts`, or regenerates the manifest, say so in the report and the PR body. Then merge `origin/main` after #27361 lands, before you hand back. Measure open PRs on every file you touch at your first edit.

### Card

#27372 is rows 2–4 of #27355 (HotCRM's 18.2.0 browser pass), carded by this seat under triage's per-row rule. Its body holds the seat's code reading on `origin/main` `c4c515ad`; treat it as the mechanism assumptions to measure (disproof welcome):
- **Row 2.** The axis falls back to compact `formatYTick`. The data label calls `formatterFor(axis.format)` with no fallback, so it prints the raw number.
- **Row 3.** `LabelList position="top"` on the tallest bar lands in the top margin. A dashboard table's last column is clipped by a parent; first measure which widget it is.
- **Row 4.** There is a recorded decision in `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` (≈L1229) not to touch all-zero bar. The seat's lean is **will not do** with that reason, unless your measured picture shows no usable baseline or ticks.

### Measure first

Render each row in real Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) before and after, using a fixture dashboard or chart schema. HotCRM's metadata is not needed. Put the before/after readings in the report: the label text beside the axis tick, whether the label's bounding box is inside the svg, and the table's `scrollWidth` vs `clientWidth`.

### Scope

**File surface:** `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` (data label formatter and label headroom only), the one dashboard table widget the measurement names, and tests beside each. Stop on any breach of this surface and explain it in the report.

**Tests (acceptance):**
- With no authored format, a data label reads in the axis's compact units. An authored format still wins.
- With data labels on, the tallest bar's label sits inside the plot.
- The table's last column is reachable.
- **Ablation:** revert each fix and its pin goes red.

**Row 4:** a pin only if you change it. Otherwise give the "will not do" reason in the PR body.

**Hand back:** in the report, give one line per row (2, 3a, 3b, 4) saying done or will not do, so the seat can answer #27355.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate is expected; run `dispatch-gates --tier` and follow what it says. Use `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium` (S–M). Set `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. `@object-ui/plugin-charts` and `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` are published, so each one you touch takes a `patch` changeset.
